values.name: Payment impossible
values.description: Payment impossible Date/time when a payment is recorded as being impossible.

values.name: Record extraction period
values.description: Record extraction period The period for extraction of records.

values.name: Cost accounting value date
values.description: Cost accounting value date Code identifying the value date of cost accounting. Value date is the date at which the entry is to effect a balance of the account.

values.name: Open period
values.description: Open period Code identifying the period during which something is, was or will be open.

values.name: Period between issue date and maturity date
values.description: Period between issue date and maturity date Interval of time between the date when the transaction was initiated and the date when the funds need to be collected.

values.name: Before date
values.description: Before date The specified before date.

values.name: After date
values.description: After date The specified after date.

values.name: Meter reading date, next scheduled
values.description: Meter reading date, next scheduled Date on which the next reading of a meter is scheduled to take place.

values.name: Maturity date, optimal
values.description: Maturity date, optimal Date at which optimal maturity occurs.

values.name: Product ageing duration, maximum
values.description: Product ageing duration, maximum Maximum period of time during which the product is ageing.

values.name: Product ageing duration, minimum
values.description: Product ageing duration, minimum Minimum period of time during which the product is ageing.

values.name: Ultimate documentation date/time for 24-hour rule
values.description: Ultimate documentation date/time for 24-hour rule regulation of CBP (United States Customs and Border Protection) Ultimate date/time by which the documentation must be submitted in compliance with the 4-hour rule of United States Custom of Border Protection.

values.name: Departure date/time from place of loading
values.description: Departure date/time from place of loading Date/time of the departure of the goods from the place of loading.

values.name: Trade item ship date/time, earliest possible
values.description: Trade item ship date/time, earliest possible The earliest date/time that the trade item can be shipped.

values.name: Trade item ship date/time, latest possible
values.description: Trade item ship date/time, latest possible The latest date/time that the trade item can be shipped.

values.name: Start date/time, maximum buying quantity
values.description: Start date/time, maximum buying quantity The date/time from which the maximum buying quantity may be purchased.

values.name: Start date/time, minimum buying quantity
values.description: Start date/time, minimum buying quantity The date/time from which the minimum buying quantity may be purchased.

values.name: Marketing campaign end date/time, suggested
values.description: Marketing campaign end date/time, suggested The date and or time suggested for the marketing campaign to end.

values.name: Marketing campaign start date/time, suggested
values.description: Marketing campaign start date/time, suggested The date and or time suggested for the marketing campaign to start.

values.name: Start availability date
values.description: Start availability date The start date of availability.

values.name: Seasonal availabilty calendar year
values.description: Seasonal availabilty calendar year The calendar year of the season in which the trade item is available.

values.name: Goods pickup lead time
values.description: Goods pickup lead time Minimum time required between order entry and goods release for pick-up.

values.name: Change date/time, latest
values.description: Change date/time, latest Most recent date and/or time that the information has been changed.

values.name: End date/time, maximum buying quantity
values.description: End date/time, maximum buying quantity The date and/or time until which the maximum buying quantity may be purchased.

values.name: End dat/time, minimum buying quantity
values.description: End dat/time, minimum buying quantity The date and/or time until which the minimum buying quantity may be purchased.

values.name: End date/time of exclusivity
values.description: End date/time of exclusivity The date and/or time until which a product is exclusive.

values.name: Data release date
values.description: Data release date The date at which the data is released.

values.name: Handling start date and/or time, actual
values.description: Handling start date and/or time, actual The actual date and/or time when the start of the handling action takes place.

values.name: Handling end date and/or time, estimated
values.description: Handling end date and/or time, estimated The date and/or time when the end of the handling action is estimated to take place.

values.name: Handling end date and/or time, actual
values.description: Handling end date and/or time, actual The actual date and/or time when the end of the handling action takes place.

values.name: Minimum product lifespan for consumer
values.description: Minimum product lifespan for consumer The minimum life span of the product remaining after selling it to the consumer, i.e. between the "sell by date" and the "use by date" of the product.

values.name: Entry date, elected
values.description: Entry date, elected Date used at the discretion of the filer for duty calculation of non-quota goods when there is no immediate transport entry date (related to immediate delivery).

values.name: Arrival date/time at initial port with the intent to unload
values.description: Arrival date/time at initial port with the intent to unload Date/ time that the conveyance arrives at the initial port in the country of destination.

values.name: Conveyance port activity date/ time
values.description: Conveyance port activity date/ time The date and time of conveyance activity, including cargo loading or unloading, fuelling etc.

values.name: Date and time of importation into port limits
values.description: Date and time of importation into port limits Date and time on which the conveyance transporting the goods from the foreign country arrived within the limits of the port of destination.

values.name: Free trade zone commodity status assignment date
values.description: Free trade zone commodity status assignment date The filing date that corresponds to the current status of the commodity in the free trade zone.

values.name: Jurisdiction entry date/time, actual
values.description: Jurisdiction entry date/time, actual Actual date/time at which the conveyance or goods enter an agency's jurisdiction.

values.name: Inspection start date/time
values.description: Inspection start date/time Date/time at which an inspection begins.

values.name: Inspection end date/time
values.description: Inspection end date/time Date/time at which an inspection is completed.

values.name: Document/message rejection date/time
values.description: Document/message rejection date/time Date/time at which the document/message was rejected.

values.name: Government service date/time, requested
values.description: Government service date/time, requested The date/time at which the government service is requested to be executed.

values.name: Crop year
values.description: Crop year The year that the crops were grown.

values.name: Date of original manufacture
values.description: Date of original manufacture Date that the item was originally manufactured.

values.name: Model year
values.description: Model year The model year of the item.

values.name: Opened trade item life span
values.description: Opened trade item life span The number of days the trade item that has been opened can remain on the shelf before it must be removed.

values.name: Unmooring, date and time
values.description: Unmooring, date and time Date and time of unmooring.

values.name: First crane lift
values.description: First crane lift Date and time of the first crane lift.

values.name: Last crane lift
values.description: Last crane lift Date and time of the last crane lift.

values.name: Reprocessing date/time
values.description: Reprocessing date/time Date/time on which goods previously produced are re- processed.

values.name: First returnable date/time
values.description: First returnable date/time The first date/time on or after which items can be returned.

values.name: Community visibility date/time
values.description: Community visibility date/time The date/time from which information becomes visible to the target community.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
